Its combat capabilities aren't much better than the standard wooden shield, but it found popularity for its design.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 12 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Emblazoned Shield}} Emblazoned Shields are [[Shield]]s featuring a traditional design from the [[Necluda]] [[Region]]. This design has lead to the Shield finding popularity, even though they do not provide much protection when compared to [[Wooden Shield]]s. They can be found in many locations, particularly within [[East Necluda]] and the [[Hebra Mountains]]. One can be located in a Treasure Chest in the [[Gatepost Town Ruins]] near [[Oman Au Shrine]]. Alternatively, there is one at the [[Equestrian Riding Course]]. An Shield can also be obtained from [[Selmie]] if Link completes the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] [[Mini-Game]] between 3:00 and 3:15.{{Cite|A shiny new record deserves a shiny new shield. Here y'go!|Selmie|BotW}} Several travelers also carry an Emblazoned Shield on their journeys. Being made of wood, Emblazoned Shields will burn and eventually disintegrate if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]].
